scripts.build: esbuild src/app.js --bundle --minify --outfile=../assets/app.js && MOD="$(go env GOPATH)/pkg/mod/github.com/axadrn/shadcn-templ/v2@v2.0.0-beta.13" && cp src/style.css src/.build.css && printf '\n@source "%s/components";\n' "$MOD" >> src/.build.css && tailwindcss -i src/.build.css -o ../assets/style.css --minify; status=$?; rm -f src/.build.css; exit $status
